tasks.acceptance_prose:
CHROME2 of the OO visual-parity program (CHROME1 landed: logo+tabs row 1, gray band, chevron translate-scroll — scripts/chrome-probe.mjs is the regression harness, keep it green).

GROUND TRUTH: /home/weiss/git/World-Office/wo-test-harness/census/census/census-oo-deep.json (read-only). Its tabs.<name>.buttons[] carry x/y/w/h per OO control. OO Home row1 (y<90): font family/size, grow/shrink, change case, bullets, numbering, multilevel, decrease/increase indent, line spacing, text direction, find/replace. Row2 (y>=90): bold/italic/underline/strike, sub/superscript, highlight, font color, clear style, the 4 alignments, nonprinting, shading, borders, select all. EVERY OO tab is two rows. THE TASK: WO's 12 .ribbon-page[data-tab] are single-line flex-nowrap — split each into TWO .ribbon-row children ordered per the OO census y-buckets.

ALGORITHM (do it mechanically): for each WO tab, map each existing WO control to its OO counterpart (the census-wo deep walk + the parity matcher already established the cmd↔OO mapping; OO controls carry .cmd/.label — match by our data-cmd semantics, e.g. bold↔Bold, fontSelect↔Font, list bullets↔Bullets). Controls whose OO counterpart has y<90 go to .ribbon-row.first, y>=90 → .ribbon-row.second, preserving OO x-order within each row. WO-only controls (no OO counterpart — e.g. WO extras) keep their current relative position at the END of the row that matches their current group neighbors. Do NOT delete or rename any control: census counts (12 tabs, 198 controls) and all *.test.mjs pins must stay green — only DOM position inside the page changes.

STRUCTURE: .ribbon-page.active becomes column layout (two .ribbon-row children stacked, each flex nowrap, gap 2-4px); band min-height ~OO (two 28-32px rows + padding ≈ 76-84px content + border). The CHROME1 chevron translation (editor.js updateRibbonScroll transforms the active page) must translate BOTH rows: transform stays on .ribbon-page (parent) — verify the .menu-list dropdowns still hang below their triggers and stay visible (overflow-y:visible on band, position:absolute top:100% relative to buttons inside the transformed subtree — transform creates a containing block, dropdowns move WITH the translate, which is correct).

POLISH (OO classic-light look): tab strip height 28-32px, OO font sizes (tabs ~12-13px, controls 13px), group separators .rb-sep = 1px #d0d0d0 with 4px vertical inset, group hover states (#e8e8e8), active/pressed (#d8d8d8), icon buttons 26-28px square, consistent 2px gaps, focus rings subtle. Check DARK theme equivalents (prefers/wo-theme=dark: separators #3a3a3a, hover #3f3f3f). Screenshot-check at 1440 and 900 px against obvious misalignment (baseline-align all icons + selects vertically: align-items:center per row).

DELIVERABLES:
1. index.html: two-row structure per tab (ONLY reorder/move existing controls into .ribbon-row.first/.second; no control loss). 2. style.css: page column layout, rows, band height, typography, separators, hover/active, dark variants. 3. editor.js: chevron code adjustments if needed (scrollWidth math now the page, unchanged conceptually), no regressions. 4. scripts/rows-probe.mjs (port 18053, same recipe as chrome-probe.mjs): for EVERY tab (activate via .ribbon-tab click): assert exactly 2 non-empty .ribbon-row children on the active page; assert specific OO anchor placements — Home: font family in row1 & bold in row2; Insert (table/picture row1, header/footer/footnote row2 per census); Layout: margins/orientation row1; assert all controls still visible (clientWidth>0) at 1440px for the two lightest tabs and no control lost across tabs (total census-visible count per tab unchanged vs pre-change snapshot you take first); chevrons at 900px still scroll (transform changes; dropdown opens below band fully visible). 5. rows-gate.test.mjs static pins: every .ribbon-page has two .ribbon-row children; home row1 contains the font select, row2 contains data-cmd bold. 6. Update any test pinning single-row structure (grep ribbon-row in tests). 7. Commit incrementally 'feat(CHROME2-TWO-ROW-RIBBON)'.

tasks.acceptance_prose:
CHROME3 of the OO visual-parity program (depends CHROME2). Two surfaces: the File backstage and the statusbar.

1. BACKSTAGE (OO File screen): currently #btn-file opens #file-menu dropdown (ul.menu-list with ~13 items, data-cmd wired: closeFileMenu/Back, plus existing actions). REBUILD as an OO-style full-screen overlay: click File (or the file backstage trigger) → fixed overlay covering the whole app (left vertical rail ~260px, dark slate/indigo tint like OO classic-light #404040-ish or OO blue-gray — pick to match our palette vars, light AND dark themes), rail = the existing menu entries as big nav rows (Back at top, then the existing items grouped OO-style: document actions, recent/info, print, help/about), right side = content pane (paper-white) showing a simple pane per nav item: for actions that already have dialogs, the pane shows a short description + big primary button that triggers the EXISTING data-cmd/dialog (do not re-implement features — this is chrome). Keep EVERY existing data-cmd reachable (no feature loss; tests reference file-menu items by data-cmd — keep those buttons in the DOM, e.g. render the old list inside the rail or as hidden fallback if cleaner: prefer rail rows carrying the same data-cmd). Esc closes (register overlay id in DIALOG_IDS routing so the global Esc works — follow how other fullscreen overlays do it), Back button closes, clicking outside pane not needed (modal). aria-modal + role=dialog + label; Tab trap per house pattern. i18n EVERY new string en+de (FileScreen.* namespace).
2. STATUSBAR (OO cluster): OO census statusbar = word-count left (clickable), page info slots, language 'English – United States' near right (btn-cnt-lang), zoom cluster far right. Our statusbar has 8 items incl. page indicator, word count, zoom controls (BUG5: ctrl+wheel, buttons). RESTYLE to OO: light-gray bar (light theme), left cluster: page-of indicator + word count (both clickable as today), right cluster: language indicator (NEW: shows current spell/lang from the spellcheck module — read the existing lang state, spellcheck uses a lang; render 'English'/'Deutsch' label, clickable → opens existing language/spellcheck dialog or settings dialog lang row), then view toggles + zoom controls. No functionality removed; keep all existing ids/buttons (statusbar tests pin some). Dark theme equivalents.

DELIVERABLES: 1. index.html backstage overlay + statusbar restructure; 2. editor.js backstage open/close routing (DIALOG_IDS + Esc), statusbar lang sync (re-run on applyLocale + spell-lang change), keep all existing handlers; 3. i18n.js en+de keys; 4. style.css both themes; 5. scripts/backstage-probe.mjs (port 18054): File click → overlay visible covering viewport (rect == viewport), rail nav rows exist with the same data-cmds as before (assert each old data-cmd still present), Back + Esc close, Tab trap contained, statusbar: lang label visible + matches t.lng, zoom cluster right of lang (x greater), word count left half; 0 pageerrors; 6. backstage-gate.test.mjs static pins (overlay id in DIALOG_IDS, i18n keys present en+de, old file-menu data-cmds preserved); 7. Update tests pinning #file-menu structure if any (grep). 8. Commit incrementally 'feat(CHROME3-BACKSTAGE-STATUSBAR)'.
